FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Pharma_FluidBedDryer_NIR
(*
========================================================================================================================
  PROJECT      : PHARMACEUTICAL CONTINUOUS SOLID DOSAGE MANUFACTURING (ORAL SOLID DOSAGE - OSD)
  SUBSYSTEM    : CONTINUOUS FLUID BED DRYER (FBD) — IN-LINE NIR MOISTURE CLOSED LOOP & AIR VELOCITY PROFILING
  DESIGNATION  : SIL-2 / CLASS I DIV 1 (DUST/SOLVENT ATEX) PROCESS CYBER-PHYSICAL AUTOMATION CONTROLLER
  SPECIFICATION: IEC 61131-3 3RD EDITION / FDA 21 CFR PART 11 / cGMP PAT FRAMEWORK / GAMP 5 / ISA-88 / ISA-18.2
  AUTHOR       : PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (LUMINA SWARM)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  THEORETICAL AND CYBER-PHYSICAL FORMULATION:
    1. CONTINUOUS FLUID BED DRYING KINETICS & PSYCHROMETRIC MASS-HEAT BALANCE:
       Continuous fluid bed drying of pharmaceutical wet granules (e.g. Paracetamol / Lactose / MCC formulations)
       exhibits two distinct drying regimes:
         a) Constant-Rate Drying Period: Free surface moisture evaporation governed by gas-film mass transfer:
            R_c = (k_y * M_w / (R * T_f)) * (p_w,sat(T_w) - p_w,gas)
            Granule bed temperature stabilizes near wet-bulb temperature T_wb (typically 32.0 - 38.0 deg C).
         b) Falling-Rate Drying Period: Capillary and Knudsen diffusion-controlled moisture transport inside pores:
            dX/dt = - K_d * (X - X_eq)
            Bed temperature rises towards the inlet drying gas temperature, demanding strict thermal capping to prevent
            API thermal degradation, phase polymorphic transition, or caramelization/coking.
       Psychrometric continuous water mass balance across the chamber:
         dm_water/dt = rho_air * V_air_dry * (Y_exhaust - Y_inlet)
         where Y is absolute humidity in [kg water / kg dry air].
         Inferential moisture prediction soft-sensor provides real-time cross-validation against optical NIR data.

    2. GELDART HYDRODYNAMICS & DYNAMIC FLUIDIZING AIR VELOCITY PROFILING:
       Pharmaceutical wet granules belong to Geldart Group A (aeratable) transitioning to Group B (sand-like).
       Minimum fluidization velocity U_mf is modeled by the Ergun equation:
         150 * ((1 - eps_mf) / eps_mf^3) * (mu_air * U_mf / (phi_s * d_p)^2) + 1.75 * (1 / eps_mf^3) * (rho_air * U_mf^2 / (phi_s * d_p)) = (rho_p - rho_air) * g
       Crucially, wet granules possess high bulk density (rho_bulk ~ 650-750 kg/m3) and liquid bridges (cohesive capillary forces),
       requiring high initial fluidization velocity (U_0 ~ 1.8 - 2.4 m/s) to avoid defluidization, wet cake agglomeration,
       and channeling. As granules dry, moisture drops (18% -> 2%), particle density decreases (rho_bulk ~ 350-450 kg/m3),
       and terminal settling velocity U_t drops. Consequently, the controller dynamically profiles face velocity:
         U_target(X) = U_mf_dry * (1.0 + alpha_moist * (X / X_initial)^beta)
       This prevents particle elutriation, excessive fine carryover to exhaust filter bags, and attrition.

    3. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) IN-LINE NIR SPECTROSCOPIC VOTING:
       Three immersion NIR transflectance probes (multiplexed InGaAs diode-array detectors, 1100-2100 nm, targeting
       the 1450 nm first overtone of O-H stretching and 1940 nm combination band of water) continuously measure
       Loss On Drying (LOD / % w/w moisture).
       The voting engine monitors:
         - Discrepancy delta between probe pairs (|Probe_i - Probe_j| > 0.65% w/w).
         - Optical fouling / window coating detection via baseline drift and reflectance attenuation.
         - Graceful fallback: 2oo3 -> 2oo2 -> 1oo1 -> Psychrometric Mass Balance Soft Sensor.

    4. MULTIVARIABLE DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC):
       Discretized 4-state state-space plant with dt = 0.5 s:
         x[k+1] = A * x[k] + B * u[k] + E * d[k]
         y[k]   = C * x[k]
       State Vector:
         x[0] = delta_X_moist   (deviation from target moisture [% w/w])
         x[1] = delta_T_bed     (deviation from target bed temperature [deg C])
         x[2] = delta_U_air     (fluidization face velocity tracking error [m/s])
         x[3] = dP_bed_rate     (derivative of distributor/bed differential pressure [mbar/s])
       Manipulated Vector:
         u[0] = Delta Inlet Air Heating Duty [%]
         u[1] = Delta Fluidization Blower VFD Speed [%]
         u[2] = Delta Rotary Discharge Weir Position [mm]
       Disturbance Vector:
         d[0] = Wet granule mass feed rate variance [kg/h]
         d[1] = Ambient air supply moisture fluctuation [g/kg]

    5. ISA-88 / ISA-18.2 FAULT TOLERANCE & GRACEFUL DEGRADATION:
       Multi-tiered safety interlocking: chamber negative pressure containment (-1.5 to -3.0 mbar) to guarantee zero
       potent drug dust release, pulse-jet filter blinding avoidance, thermal run-away suppression, and controlled
       inert cooling fallback during emergency trips.
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Safety Interlocks & Operating Modes --- *)
    bMasterPermissive           : BOOL;     (* Master process safety and system train permissive [TRUE=Run Permitted] *)
    bSafetyEStopOk              : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 emergency stop circuit [TRUE=Healthy, FALSE=Tripped] *)
    bAutoModeSelect             : BOOL;     (* Supervisory mode: TRUE = Full Closed-Loop MPC, FALSE = Safe Coordinated Manual *)

    (* --- In-Line Analytical PAT Instrumentation (Triple Redundant NIR Probes) --- *)
    rNIR_Moisture_Probe1        : REAL;     (* Redundant In-Line NIR moisture probe 1 [% w/w] (0.00 .. 30.00 %) *)
    rNIR_Moisture_Probe2        : REAL;     (* Redundant In-Line NIR moisture probe 2 [% w/w] (0.00 .. 30.00 %) *)
    rNIR_Moisture_Probe3        : REAL;     (* Redundant In-Line NIR moisture probe 3 [% w/w] (0.00 .. 30.00 %) *)

    (* --- Process Thermal & Aerodynamic Instrumentation --- *)
    rInletAirTemp_DegC          : REAL;     (* Process inlet conditioning supply air temperature [deg C] (20.0 .. 120.0) *)
    rExhaustAirTemp_DegC        : REAL;     (* Exhaust air plenum freeboard temperature [deg C] (20.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rBedProductTemp_DegC        : REAL;     (* Fluidized bed internal product core temperature [deg C] (20.0 .. 90.0) *)
    rFluidizingAirVelocity_ms   : REAL;     (* Real-time face velocity across distributor plate [m/s] (0.20 .. 4.00) *)
    rInletAirFlow_m3h           : REAL;     (* Primary inlet supply air volumetric flow rate [m3/h] (500.0 .. 15000.0) *)
    rBedPressureDrop_mbar       : REAL;     (* Differential pressure across distributor plate and granule bed [mbar] (2.0 .. 60.0) *)
    rFilterBagDiffPress_mbar    : REAL;     (* Exhaust pulse-jet filter bag differential pressure [mbar] (1.0 .. 40.0) *)
    rChamberPressure_mbar       : REAL;     (* FBD internal freeboard draft gauge pressure [mbar] (-15.0 .. 5.0) *)

    (* --- Material Feed & Psychrometric Air Boundary Instrumentation --- *)
    rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh     : REAL;     (* Upstream continuous wet granulator feed rate [kg/h] (0.0 .. 600.0) *)
    rInletAirHumidity_gkg       : REAL;     (* Dehumidified supply air absolute humidity [g/kg dry air] (0.5 .. 15.0) *)
    rExhaustAirHumidity_gkg     : REAL;     (* Exhaust air plenum absolute humidity [g/kg dry air] (2.0 .. 50.0) *)
    bFilterBlowbackActive       : BOOL;     (* Exhaust filter bag pneumatic reverse-jet pulsing active discrete signal *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Actuation Commands & Control Setpoints --- *)
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Overall automation engine operational readiness indicator *)
    bDegradedModeActive         : BOOL;     (* Operating in degraded TMR sensor or psychrometric soft-sensor fallback mode *)
    rInletHeaterDuty_Pct        : REAL;     (* Modulated steam heat exchanger / electric heating battery SCR output [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct         : REAL;     (* Inlet supply fluidization blower VFD speed command [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rExhaustFanDraft_Pct        : REAL;     (* Induced draft exhaust fan VFD command for chamber negative pressure [%] (0.0 .. 100.0) *)
    rDischargeWeirHeight_mm     : REAL;     (* Continuous rotary discharge valve / active weir position [mm] (0.0 .. 250.0) *)
    rTargetAirVelocity_ms       : REAL;     (* Dynamic model-derived fluidizing air velocity setpoint [m/s] (0.50 .. 3.20) *)

    (* --- Validated Process Values, Diagnostics & Status Words --- *)
    rVotedMoisture_Pct          : REAL;     (* Validated 2oo3 TMR resolved granule moisture content [% w/w] *)
    rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct  : REAL;     (* Inferential soft-sensor granule moisture from psychrometric mass balance [% w/w] *)
    rCalculatedDryingRate_PctMin: REAL;     (* Computed real-time drying rate [% moisture / min] *)
    wAlarmWord                  : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed alarm status register (Bit0=Critical, Bit1=Thermal, etc.) *)
    wSystemStatusWord           : WORD;     (* Diagnostic and operational state machine status indicator word *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- State Machine Registers --- *)
    iState                      : INT := 0; (* Active operational state index *)
    iPreviousState              : INT := 0; (* Historical state transition tracker *)

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3 TMR) Voting Registers --- *)
    bProbe1_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bProbe2_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bProbe3_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthyProbeCount          : INT  := 3;
    rDelta12                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta23                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta31                    : REAL := 0.0;
    rTmrToleranceLimit          : REAL := 0.65; (* Maximum allowable inter-probe divergence [% w/w] *)

    (* --- State-Space Discrete Model Representation (Sampling Period dt = 0.5 s) --- *)
    (* State Vector x:
         x[0] = delta_X_moist   (granule moisture deviation from setpoint: X - X_sp [% w/w])
         x[1] = delta_T_bed     (bed core temperature deviation from setpoint: T - T_sp [deg C])
         x[2] = delta_U_air     (fluidization velocity deviation from profiled setpoint [m/s])
         x[3] = dP_bed_rate     (derivative of distributor and bed differential pressure [mbar/s])
    *)
    rState_x1_MoistErr          : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x2_BedTempErr        : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x3_VelocityErr       : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x4_BedDpRate         : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Linearized Discrete Plant Matrices (A & B) *)
    rA11 : REAL := 0.9650;  rA12 : REAL := -0.0120; rA13 : REAL := -0.0450; rA14 : REAL :=  0.0020;
    rA21 : REAL := 0.0080;  rA22 : REAL :=  0.9400; rA23 : REAL :=  0.0350; rA24 : REAL :=  0.0000;
    rA31 : REAL := 0.0000;  rA32 : REAL :=  0.0000; rA33 : REAL :=  0.8800; rA34 : REAL := -0.0150;
    rA41 : REAL := 0.0250;  rA42 : REAL :=  0.0000; rA43 : REAL :=  0.1200; rA44 : REAL :=  0.8200;

    rB11 : REAL := -0.0085; (* Heat duty impact on moisture reduction [% / %-duty] *)
    rB12 : REAL := -0.0140; (* Velocity impact on surface water mass transfer *)
    rB13 : REAL :=  0.0045; (* Weir height / bed holdup impact on residence time *)
    rB21 : REAL :=  0.0650; (* Thermal transfer authority from heating battery *)
    rB22 : REAL := -0.0220; (* Convective evaporative cooling rate *)
    rB32 : REAL :=  0.0380; (* Supply fan VFD speed coupling to face velocity *)
    rB42 : REAL :=  0.0520; (* Air drag coupling on distributor pressure drop *)
    rB43 : REAL :=  0.0180; (* Bed mass holdup authority on differential pressure *)

    (* Model Predictive Control Horizon Prediction Accumulators *)
    rPredMoistHorizonErr        : REAL := 0.0;
    rPredBedTempHorizonErr      : REAL := 0.0;
    rPredVelocityHorizonErr     : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Dynamic Fluidizing Air Velocity Geldart Profiling Coefficients *)
    rU_mf_DryBaseline           : REAL := 0.95; (* Minimum fluidization velocity of dry finished granules [m/s] *)
    rAlphaMoistureScaling       : REAL := 1.15; (* Hydrodynamic drag coefficient modifier for wet capillary bridges *)
    rBetaMoistureExponent       : REAL := 0.68; (* Empirical exponent for moisture-to-velocity profile *)
    rNominalInletMoisture       : REAL := 18.0; (* Baseline upstream wet granulator moisture [% w/w] *)

    (* Psychrometric Inferential Soft Sensor Registers *)
    rAirDensity_kgm3            : REAL := 1.164; (* Air density at mean chamber conditions [kg/m3] *)
    rWaterEvaporationRate_kgh   : REAL := 0.0;   (* Dynamic water evaporation mass rate [kg/h] *)
    rDrySolidMassFlow_kgh       : REAL := 120.0; (* Dry granule throughput mass rate [kg/h] *)
    rPsychrometricMoistureAccum : REAL := 2.20;  (* Internal integrated soft-sensor moisture [% w/w] *)

    (* Signal Conditioning, Derivatives & Digital Filters *)
    rInletTemp_Filt             : REAL := 60.0;
    rExhaustTemp_Filt           : REAL := 38.0;
    rBedTemp_Filt               : REAL := 42.0;
    rAirVelocity_Filt           : REAL := 1.40;
    rBedDp_Filt                 : REAL := 18.0;
    rChamberPress_Filt          : REAL := -2.0;
    rPreviousBedDp              : REAL := 18.0;
    rPreviousVotedMoist         : REAL := 2.20;

    (* Target Process Setpoints & Quality By Design (QbD) Design Space Constraints *)
    rTargetMoisture_Pct         : REAL := 2.20; (* Critical Quality Attribute (CQA) target moisture [% w/w] *)
    rTargetBedTemp_DegC         : REAL := 42.0; (* Critical Process Parameter (CPP) product temperature [deg C] *)
    rTargetChamberPress_mbar    : REAL := -2.0; (* Negative draft pressure containment setpoint [mbar] *)
    rMaxInletAirTemp_DegC       : REAL := 82.0; (* cGMP maximum thermal safety ceiling [deg C] *)
    rMaxBedProductTemp_DegC     : REAL := 50.0; (* Maximum allowable product core temperature [deg C] *)
    rMinFluidizingVelocity_ms   : REAL := 0.70; (* Critical minimum velocity to prevent bed collapse [m/s] *)
    rMaxFluidizingVelocity_ms   : REAL := 2.85; (* Critical maximum velocity to prevent elutriation [m/s] *)

    (* Chamber Negative Pressure PI Controller Registers *)
    rPressIntegralTerm          : REAL := 0.0;
    rPressKp                    : REAL := 3.20;
    rPressKi                    : REAL := 0.45;

    (* Timers & Watchdogs *)
    tonStartupPurge             : TON;
    tonTmrFaultDebounce         : TON;
    tonDefluidizationSustained  : TON;
    tonStateDwell               : TON;

    (* Operational Diagnostics & Lifecycle Statistics *)
    udiCycleCounter             : UDINT := 0;
    udiDefluidizationMitigations: UDINT := 0;
    udiPsychrometricFallbackCycles: UDINT := 0;
    rCumulativeEnergy_kWh       : REAL := 0.0;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC EXECUTION ROUTINE (IEC 61131-3 TASK EXECUTION dt = 500 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

udiCycleCounter := udiCycleCounter + 1;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: CRITICAL HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & THERMAL SAFETY ENVELOPE
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bSafetyEStopOk THEN
    (* Deterministic Fail-Safe Trip Conditions *)
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
    rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 0.0;   (* Immediate thermal cut-off *)
    rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 15.0;  (* Minimum safety cooling and vessel sweep *)
    rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 25.0;  (* Maintain negative pressure containment *)
    rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 0.0;   (* Isolate product discharge port *)
    rTargetAirVelocity_ms   := 0.50;

    wAlarmWord.0            := TRUE;  (* Hardwired Emergency Stop Tripped *)
    wSystemStatusWord       := 16#F000;
    iState                  := 99;    (* Force to emergency cooling state *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wAlarmWord.0 := FALSE;

(* Secondary Critical Over-Temperature Emergency Interlock *)
IF (rBedProductTemp_DegC > rMaxBedProductTemp_DegC + 5.0) OR (rInletAirTemp_DegC > rMaxInletAirTemp_DegC + 10.0) THEN
    bSystemReady            := FALSE;
    rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 0.0;
    rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 25.0;  (* Aggressive cooling purge *)
    rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 35.0;
    rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 0.0;
    wAlarmWord.1            := TRUE;  (* Critical Thermal Over-Limit Trip *)
    wSystemStatusWord       := 16#F001;
    iState                  := 99;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wAlarmWord.1 := FALSE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) IN-LINE NIR SPECTROSCOPIC VOTING ALGORITHM
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Step 2.1: InGaAs Probe Physical Boundary Plausibility Validation [0.10% to 35.00% w/w LOD] *)
bProbe1_Valid := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 >= 0.10) AND (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 <= 35.00);
bProbe2_Valid := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe2 >= 0.10) AND (rNIR_Moisture_Probe2 <= 35.00);
bProbe3_Valid := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe3 >= 0.10) AND (rNIR_Moisture_Probe3 <= 35.00);

(* Step 2.2: Compute Cross-Probe Discrepancy Matrix *)
rDelta12 := ABS(rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 - rNIR_Moisture_Probe2);
rDelta23 := ABS(rNIR_Moisture_Probe2 - rNIR_Moisture_Probe3);
rDelta31 := ABS(rNIR_Moisture_Probe3 - rNIR_Moisture_Probe1);

(* Step 2.3: Determine Consensus and Isolate Drifting or Window-Fouled Probe *)
IF bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe2_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid THEN
    IF (rDelta12 <= rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta23 <= rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta31 <= rTmrToleranceLimit) THEN
        (* All three optical channels in tight consensus: 2oo3 Mean *)
        rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe2 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe3) / 3.0;
        iHealthyProbeCount := 3;
        wAlarmWord.2       := FALSE; (* TMR Warning Cleared *)
        wAlarmWord.3       := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDelta12 <= rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit) THEN
        (* Probe 3 drifting or window coated: Exclude Probe 3, vote 1 and 2 *)
        rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe2) / 2.0;
        bProbe3_Valid      := FALSE;
        iHealthyProbeCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2       := TRUE;  (* Single Probe Divergence Alarm *)
        wAlarmWord.3       := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDelta23 <= rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit) THEN
        (* Probe 1 drifting: Exclude Probe 1, vote 2 and 3 *)
        rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe2 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe3) / 2.0;
        bProbe1_Valid      := FALSE;
        iHealthyProbeCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2       := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.3       := FALSE;
    ELSIF (rDelta31 <= rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit) AND (rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit) THEN
        (* Probe 2 drifting: Exclude Probe 2, vote 1 and 3 *)
        rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe3) / 2.0;
        bProbe2_Valid      := FALSE;
        iHealthyProbeCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2       := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.3       := FALSE;
    ELSE
        (* Total TMR Incoherence: Divergence across all channels *)
        rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe2 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe3) / 3.0;
        iHealthyProbeCount := 1;
        wAlarmWord.2       := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.3       := TRUE;  (* Severe TMR Incoherence Fault *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe2_Valid THEN
    rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe2) / 2.0;
    iHealthyProbeCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2       := TRUE;
ELSIF bProbe2_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid THEN
    rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe2 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe3) / 2.0;
    iHealthyProbeCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2       := TRUE;
ELSIF bProbe1_Valid AND bProbe3_Valid THEN
    rVotedMoisture_Pct := (rNIR_Moisture_Probe1 + rNIR_Moisture_Probe3) / 2.0;
    iHealthyProbeCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2       := TRUE;
ELSIF bProbe1_Valid THEN
    rVotedMoisture_Pct := rNIR_Moisture_Probe1;
    iHealthyProbeCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3       := TRUE;
ELSIF bProbe2_Valid THEN
    rVotedMoisture_Pct := rNIR_Moisture_Probe2;
    iHealthyProbeCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3       := TRUE;
ELSIF bProbe3_Valid THEN
    rVotedMoisture_Pct := rNIR_Moisture_Probe3;
    iHealthyProbeCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3       := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total Optical Sensor Loss: Revert to Psychrometric Inferential Soft Sensor *)
    rVotedMoisture_Pct := rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct;
    iHealthyProbeCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord.3       := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: PROCESS VARIABLE CONDITIONING, PSYCHROMETRIC BALANCE & HYDRODYNAMICS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* First-Order Digital Low-Pass Filters (Sample time dt = 0.5 s) *)
rInletTemp_Filt    := (rInletTemp_Filt * 0.85) + (rInletAirTemp_DegC * 0.15);
rExhaustTemp_Filt  := (rExhaustTemp_Filt * 0.80) + (rExhaustAirTemp_DegC * 0.20);
rBedTemp_Filt      := (rBedTemp_Filt * 0.80) + (rBedProductTemp_DegC * 0.20);
rAirVelocity_Filt  := (rAirVelocity_Filt * 0.75) + (rFluidizingAirVelocity_ms * 0.25);
rBedDp_Filt        := (rBedDp_Filt * 0.70) + (rBedPressureDrop_mbar * 0.30);
rChamberPress_Filt := (rChamberPress_Filt * 0.75) + (rChamberPressure_mbar * 0.25);

(* Differential Pressure Derivative [mbar/s] *)
rState_x4_BedDpRate := (rBedDp_Filt - rPreviousBedDp) / 0.5;
rPreviousBedDp      := rBedDp_Filt;

(* Drying Rate Computation [% moisture / min] *)
rCalculatedDryingRate_PctMin := ((rPreviousVotedMoist - rVotedMoisture_Pct) / 0.5) * 60.0;
rPreviousVotedMoist          := rVotedMoisture_Pct;

(* Continuous Chamber Psychrometric Water Mass Balance Soft Sensor *)
IF (rInletAirFlow_m3h > 100.0) AND (rExhaustAirHumidity_gkg > rInletAirHumidity_gkg) THEN
    (* Evaporative Water Mass Flux: m_evap = rho_air * V_air * Delta_Y [kg/h] *)
    rWaterEvaporationRate_kgh := rAirDensity_kgm3 * rInletAirFlow_m3h * ((rExhaustAirHumidity_gkg - rInletAirHumidity_gkg) / 1000.0);
    IF rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh > 10.0 THEN
        (* Continuous mass fraction conservation soft sensor *)
        rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct := ((rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh * (rNominalInletMoisture / 100.0) - rWaterEvaporationRate_kgh) 
                                      / rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh) * 100.0;
        IF rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct < 0.20 THEN
            rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct := 0.20;
        ELSIF rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct > 28.0 THEN
            rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct := 28.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct := rVotedMoisture_Pct;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rWaterEvaporationRate_kgh  := 0.0;
    rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct := rVotedMoisture_Pct;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Fluidizing Face Velocity Profiling (Geldart Group A/B Hydrodynamic Function) *)
IF rVotedMoisture_Pct > 0.50 THEN
    (* Power-law hydrodynamic scaling of minimum fluidization velocity with granule liquid content *)
    rTargetAirVelocity_ms := rU_mf_DryBaseline * (1.0 + rAlphaMoistureScaling * EXPT((rVotedMoisture_Pct / rNominalInletMoisture), rBetaMoistureExponent));
ELSE
    rTargetAirVelocity_ms := rU_mf_DryBaseline;
END_IF;

(* Bound Target Face Velocity to Prevent Bed Channeling or Fines Elutriation *)
IF rTargetAirVelocity_ms < rMinFluidizingVelocity_ms THEN
    rTargetAirVelocity_ms := rMinFluidizingVelocity_ms;
ELSIF rTargetAirVelocity_ms > rMaxFluidizingVelocity_ms THEN
    rTargetAirVelocity_ms := rMaxFluidizingVelocity_ms;
END_IF;

(* Compute Multivariable State Vector Deviations *)
rState_x1_MoistErr    := rVotedMoisture_Pct - rTargetMoisture_Pct; (* Positive = Granules too wet *)
rState_x2_BedTempErr  := rBedTemp_Filt - rTargetBedTemp_DegC;      (* Positive = Product overheating *)
rState_x3_VelocityErr := rAirVelocity_Filt - rTargetAirVelocity_ms;(* Positive = Excess superficial velocity *)

(* One-Step Receding Horizon State-Space Model Predictions *)
rPredMoistHorizonErr   := (rA11 * rState_x1_MoistErr) + (rA12 * rState_x2_BedTempErr) 
                        + (rA13 * rState_x3_VelocityErr) + (rA14 * rState_x4_BedDpRate);
rPredBedTempHorizonErr := (rA21 * rState_x1_MoistErr) + (rA22 * rState_x2_BedTempErr) 
                        + (rA23 * rState_x3_VelocityErr);
rPredVelocityHorizonErr:= (rA33 * rState_x3_VelocityErr) + (rA34 * rState_x4_BedDpRate);

(* Chamber Negative Draft Pressure Closed-Loop (PI Interlock) *)
rPressIntegralTerm := rPressIntegralTerm + (rPressKi * (rChamberPress_Filt - rTargetChamberPress_mbar) * 0.5);
IF rPressIntegralTerm > 30.0 THEN
    rPressIntegralTerm := 30.0;
ELSIF rPressIntegralTerm < -30.0 THEN
    rPressIntegralTerm := -30.0;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: SEQUENTIAL FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 MODULAR OPERATIONS)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_0_INIT_PRESTART_PURGE: Chamber Purge, Instrument Alignment & Containment Verification *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 0.0;
        rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 20.0;  (* Low-rate HEPA air duct sweep *)
        rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 30.0;  (* Establish -2.0 mbar negative pressure *)
        rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 0.0;   (* Discharge gate closed *)
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#0001;

        tonStartupPurge(IN := bMasterPermissive, PT := T#12S);
        IF tonStartupPurge.Q THEN
            tonStartupPurge(IN := FALSE);
            IF (rChamberPress_Filt <= -1.0) AND (iHealthyProbeCount >= 2) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Advance to Standby Pre-Heat *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord.6 := TRUE; (* Negative pressure failure or insufficient NIR sensors *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_10_STANDBY_AERATION_PREHEAT: Thermal Conditioning & Distributor Zero-Calibration *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        rTargetAirVelocity_ms   := 1.10;
        rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 42.0;
        rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 46.0 + (rPressKp * (rChamberPress_Filt - rTargetChamberPress_mbar)) + rPressIntegralTerm;
        rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 35.0;  (* Ramp thermal battery towards pre-heat envelope *)
        rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 40.0;  (* Baseline weir retention height *)
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#0010;

        IF bMasterPermissive AND bAutoModeSelect AND (rInletTemp_Filt >= 50.0) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Engage Model Predictive Closed-Loop Production *)
        ELSIF NOT bMasterPermissive THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_20_CLOSED_LOOP_MPC_PRODUCTION: Full NIR In-Line Feedback & Velocity Profiling *)
        bSystemReady        := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive := (iHealthyProbeCount < 3);
        wSystemStatusWord   := 16#0020;

        (* Loop A: Thermal Air Heating Control via NIR Moisture Error Prediction & Bed Temp Guard *)
        IF rState_x1_MoistErr > 0.0 THEN
            (* Product is above target moisture: Boost heating proportionally, subject to product thermal ceiling *)
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 45.0 + (rPredMoistHorizonErr * 18.50) - (rPredBedTempHorizonErr * 2.20) 
                                  + ((rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh - 100.0) * 0.08);
        ELSE
            (* Product is dry or on-target: Moderate heating to avoid API polymorphic transition *)
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 38.0 + (rPredMoistHorizonErr * 12.0) - (rPredBedTempHorizonErr * 3.50);
        END_IF;

        (* Enforce Critical Process Parameter (CPP) Thermal Limits *)
        IF rBedTemp_Filt > 46.0 THEN
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := rInletHeaterDuty_Pct * 0.70; (* Thermal throttling *)
        END_IF;
        IF rInletTemp_Filt > rMaxInletAirTemp_DegC THEN
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 20.0;
        END_IF;
        IF rInletHeaterDuty_Pct > 95.0 THEN
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 95.0;
        ELSIF rInletHeaterDuty_Pct < 5.0 THEN
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 5.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Loop B: Fluidizing Face Velocity Closed-Loop (Profiling Fan Speed Command) *)
        rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct := 35.0 + (rTargetAirVelocity_ms * 28.0) + (rPredVelocityHorizonErr * 4.50) 
                             + (rState_x4_BedDpRate * 1.80);
        IF rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct > 95.0 THEN
            rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct := 95.0;
        ELSIF rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct < 25.0 THEN
            rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct := 25.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Loop C: Chamber Draft Negative Pressure Containment *)
        rExhaustFanDraft_Pct := (rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct * 1.05) + (rPressKp * (rChamberPress_Filt - rTargetChamberPress_mbar)) + rPressIntegralTerm;
        IF rExhaustFanDraft_Pct > 98.0 THEN
            rExhaustFanDraft_Pct := 98.0;
        ELSIF rExhaustFanDraft_Pct < 20.0 THEN
            rExhaustFanDraft_Pct := 20.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Loop D: Continuous Product Discharge Weir / Rotary Valve Modulation *)
        rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 120.0 + ((rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh - 120.0) * 0.45) - (rPredMoistHorizonErr * 25.0);
        IF rDischargeWeirHeight_mm > 220.0 THEN
            rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 220.0;
        ELSIF rDischargeWeirHeight_mm < 30.0 THEN
            rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 30.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Energy accounting *)
        rCumulativeEnergy_kWh := rCumulativeEnergy_kWh + (rInletHeaterDuty_Pct * 0.45 * (0.5 / 3600.0));

        (* Dynamic Multi-Regime Operational Transitions *)
        IF (rVotedMoisture_Pct > 6.50) OR (rBedDp_Filt > 38.0) THEN
            iState := 30; (* High moisture / bed defluidization mitigation state *)
        ELSIF (rVotedMoisture_Pct < 1.35) AND (rBedTemp_Filt > 44.0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Over-drying / elutriation prevention state *)
        ELSIF (iHealthyProbeCount <= 1) THEN
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Degraded Psychrometric Fallback *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_30_WET_BED_DEFLUIDIZATION_INTERVENTION: Channeling Prevention & Hydrodynamic Surge *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0030;
        wAlarmWord.4                := TRUE; (* Defluidization risk alert *)
        udiDefluidizationMitigations:= udiDefluidizationMitigations + 1;

        (* Aggressive hydrodynamic fluidization boost to break liquid capillary bridges *)
        rTargetAirVelocity_ms   := 2.45;
        rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 82.0;
        rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 88.0 + (rPressKp * (rChamberPress_Filt - rTargetChamberPress_mbar));
        rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 78.0; (* Thermal boost to accelerate surface flash evaporation *)
        rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 60.0; (* Retain wet granules in chamber for extended drying *)

        IF rBedProductTemp_DegC > 47.0 THEN
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 50.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Exit Condition: Moisture brought below 4.0% and bed differential pressure normalized *)
        IF (rVotedMoisture_Pct <= 4.00) AND (rBedDp_Filt < 28.0) THEN
            wAlarmWord.4 := FALSE;
            iState       := 20; (* Return to Standard MPC Closed Loop *)
        ELSIF rBedDp_Filt < 4.0 THEN
            (* Complete Bed Channeling / Blowout: Fallback to emergency cooling *)
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_40_NEAR_DRY_ELUTRIATION_PREVENTION: Particle Attrition & Fines Carryover Guard *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#0040;
        wAlarmWord.9            := TRUE; (* Near-dry elutriation warning *)

        (* Lower face velocity to protect friable finished granules and avoid bag blinding *)
        rTargetAirVelocity_ms   := 0.88;
        rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 32.0;
        rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 38.0 + (rPressKp * (rChamberPress_Filt - rTargetChamberPress_mbar));
        rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 22.0; (* Throttled thermal duty to stop over-drying *)
        rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 180.0;(* Open weir to rapidly discharge dry finished batch *)

        IF (rVotedMoisture_Pct >= 1.90) OR (rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh > 150.0) THEN
            wAlarmWord.9 := FALSE;
            iState       := 20; (* Return to Standard MPC Closed Loop *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_50_DEGRADED_PSYCHROMETRIC_SOFT_SENSOR: TMR Sensor Loss Inferential Fallback *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0050;
        wAlarmWord.3                := TRUE; (* Operating on psychrometric soft sensor *)
        udiPsychrometricFallbackCycles := udiPsychrometricFallbackCycles + 1;

        (* Inferential control driven by exhaust air enthalpy and psychrometric mass balance *)
        rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 48.0 + ((rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct - rTargetMoisture_Pct) * 14.0);
        IF rInletHeaterDuty_Pct > 70.0 THEN
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 70.0; (* Cautious thermal bounding in degraded mode *)
        ELSIF rInletHeaterDuty_Pct < 15.0 THEN
            rInletHeaterDuty_Pct := 15.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Robust default fluidizing velocity *)
        rTargetAirVelocity_ms   := 1.45;
        rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 48.0;
        rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 52.0 + (rPressKp * (rChamberPress_Filt - rTargetChamberPress_mbar));
        rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 110.0;

        (* Recovery Condition: At least two NIR optical probes regain calibration consensus *)
        IF (iHealthyProbeCount >= 2) AND bAutoModeSelect THEN
            wAlarmWord.3 := FALSE;
            iState       := 20; (* Return to full closed loop MPC *)
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_99_CRITICAL_EMERGENCY_COOLING: Thermal Runaway, E-Stop or Pressure Blowout *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive     := FALSE;
        rInletHeaterDuty_Pct    := 0.0;   (* Total heating battery shutdown *)
        rSupplyFanSpeed_Pct     := 18.0;  (* Controlled nitrogen/air cooling sweep *)
        rExhaustFanDraft_Pct    := 28.0;  (* Continuous containment draft *)
        rDischargeWeirHeight_mm := 0.0;   (* Product isolation *)
        rTargetAirVelocity_ms   := 0.50;
        wSystemStatusWord       := 16#9999;

        IF bSafetyEStopOk AND (rBedProductTemp_DegC < 38.0) AND (rChamberPress_Filt <= -1.0) THEN
            iState := 0; (* Reset permitted back to pre-start *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: ISA-18.2 SECONDARY ALARM HIERARCHY & ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Pulse-Jet Baghouse Differential Pressure High Blinding Interlock *)
IF rFilterBagDiffPress_mbar > 28.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.5 := TRUE; (* Filter bag blinding hazard *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Chamber Draft Containment Loss Alarm (Negative pressure approaching atmospheric) *)
IF rChamberPress_Filt > -0.80 THEN
    wAlarmWord.6 := TRUE; (* Loss of containment draft *)
    rExhaustFanDraft_Pct := rExhaustFanDraft_Pct + 10.0; (* Rapid containment recovery boost *)
ELSIF (iState <> 0) AND (iState <> 99) THEN
    wAlarmWord.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Critical Product Quality Moisture Alarms (CQA Limits: 1.50% to 3.50% LOD) *)
IF rVotedMoisture_Pct > 3.50 THEN
    wAlarmWord.7 := TRUE; (* Out-of-specification High Moisture *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.7 := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rVotedMoisture_Pct < 1.20 THEN
    wAlarmWord.8 := TRUE; (* Product Over-Drying / Degradation Alert *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.8 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Granulator Wet Feed Starvation Detection *)
IF (rWetGranuleFeedRate_kgh < 5.0) AND (iState = 20) THEN
    wAlarmWord.10 := TRUE; (* Feed starvation - Bed draining *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.10 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Analytical Divergence: NIR Optical vs Psychrometric Mass Balance Soft Sensor *)
IF ABS(rVotedMoisture_Pct - rPsychrometricMoisture_Pct) > 1.80 THEN
    wAlarmWord.11 := TRUE; (* Analytical divergence between PAT and mass balance *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.11 := FALSE;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
